rationale: C14 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. Both are short Eisenhower letters to the Civil Aeronautics Board reviewing a proposed disposition of an airline-route case, weighing competition and subsidy concerns, changing the duration of carrier certificates, and concluding with nearly identical language requesting that the Board present a revised order for presidential approval. C11 shares the CAB certificate context and presidential direction to revise official action but lacks the distinctive revised-order formula and certificate-duration reasoning. C10 has a weaker structural resemblance involving review of an agency recommendation followed by approval of a modified result and requests for administrative action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I approve of the Board's proposed order except as it relates to the duration of the certificates for Alaska Airlines and Pacific Northern Airlines.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I desire to amend my letter of February first with reference to the West Coast-Hawaii Case.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters modify the President's disposition of a specific CAB route proceeding, focusing on which carriers receive certificates and for how long.

shared_material.child_excerpt: While three-year certificates might well encourage and facilitate such a merger, such certificates would create serious problems for both carriers in the matter of financing new equipment.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Renewing the certificates of both carriers for a limited period would afford them an equal opportunity to demonstrate their capacity to develop adequate traffic to operate without subsidy or to prove definitely that the route cannot economically support two carriers.
shared_material.explanation: Each letter selects a certificate duration by balancing carrier viability and competitive objectives against federal subsidy concerns.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly, I request that the Board present for my approval a revised order in this case that is consistent with the above comments.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Accordingly, I request the Board present' for my approval a revised order in this case which would certify both Northwest Airlines and Pan American World Airways ... for a temporary period of three years from now.
shared_material.explanation: This nearly identical operative closing is distinctive evidence that C14 supplied literal language and the administrative mechanism used in the child.
